biggest_catch: The headline 'up to $175' includes a $50 employer-program leg (TBK at Work) that requires a referral code from a participating employer - the maximum generally achievable with public requirements is $125, and the smallest single bonus is $25.
catches: Bonuses: $50 (3+ direct deposits totaling $3,000+), $25 (3+ recurring auto-transfers to a TBK savings/MM), $25 (9 bill-pay transactions to service providers), $25 (50 point-of-sale debit transactions) - all within 120 calendar days of account opening.
The additional $50 TBK at Work Bonus requires being a TBK at Work participant and providing a TBK Bank referral code (employer program).
Limit one of each bonus type; converted accounts are not eligible.
Bonuses credited the next business day after the 120-day bonus period if the account is open and active.
Cash bonus payments may be reported to the IRS as interest (taxable).
$100 minimum opening deposit; $9 monthly service charge unless a waiver condition is met (e.g., $1,000 in direct deposits or 10 POS transactions per cycle).
18+ to open online; subject to application approval.
Offer effective 6/19/2022 and 'subject to change at any time' - no stated expiry date.

steps: Open a new Everyday Checking account online or in person ($100 minimum opening deposit).
Within 120 days, have at least 3 direct deposits totaling $3,000+ (earns $50).
Within 120 days, complete 3+ recurring automatic transfers to a TBK Bank savings or money market account (earns $25).
Within 120 days, make 9+ Bill Pay transactions to service providers (earns $25).
Within 120 days, make 50+ point-of-sale debit card transactions (earns $25).
Keep the account open and active; bonuses credit the next business day after the 120-day period.
timing: Bonuses credited the next business day after the 120-day qualifying period. No expiry stated.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus $25–$125. Per official terms: Bonuses credited the next business day after the 120-day qualifying period. No expiry stated. Earliest realistic: ~5 months (fixed 120-day qualification period + the payout window — finishing early does not pay sooner).
maximize: Fastest honest path. The qualification period is a fixed calendar window — finishing the required transactions early does NOT pay the bonus sooner; the bank calculates the bonus only after the period closes. Fastest honest path: complete the required transactions in the first week so you can't forget them, then wait out the period with the account open and in good standing.
